partners.mechanism_chain: PDX1 (HGNC:9107) —DISRUPTS→ Pancreatic Beta Cell Development and Function; HNF1B (HGNC:4875) —DISRUPTS→ Kidney Development and Tubule Formation; Pancreatic Beta Cell Development and Function —LEADS_TO→ Diabetes Mellitus (HP:0000824); Kidney Development and Tubule Formation —LEADS_TO→ Renal Cysts (HP:0000114); PDX1 (HGNC:9107) —DISRUPTS→ Kidney Development and Tubule Formation; HNF1B (HGNC:4875) —DISRUPTS→ Pancreatic Beta Cell Development and Function. Mutations in PDX1 disrupt pancreatic beta cell development and function, leading to diabetes (MONDO:0011667). Simultaneously, PDX1 is also crucial for kidney development. Mutations in HNF1B disrupt kidney development and tubule formation, leading to renal cysts (MONDO:0007669). HNF1B also plays a role in pancreatic development. Thus, disruption of either PDX1 or HNF1B impacts both pancreatic and renal developmental pathways, creating a mechanistic overlap.
